title: Patient Financial Services Manual — One Patient Financial Account per Patient
content:
**1.1 Rule.** A patient holds exactly one Patient Financial Account, which carries the patient-responsibility charges of every service the patient receives from Linden Ridge Medical Group, whatever the financial class. A patient holds at most 1 account whose status is anything other than closed.

**1.2 Changes of coverage.** A change of insurance, a move between insurance and self-pay, or a new membership is recorded on the existing account through a coverage update, and never through a second account.

**1.3 Returning patients.** A patient whose only account is closed and who returns to the practice is opened a new account. The closed account, its balance history and its hold history are not reused.

**1.4 Family members.** A guarantor paying for several family members does not merge their accounts: each patient keeps one account in the patient's own name.

**1.5 Condition for opening an account.** An account is opened for a patient only when the patient holds no billing account in any status other than closed — that is, none that is registered, active, on billing hold, in precollection or in collections. This is read from the account records kept under the patient, at the time the account would be opened; it is not taken from the patient's own description.

### Judgement table for a request to open an account (hypothetical situations)

| Accounts the records show for the patient | May a new account be opened? |
|---|---|
| none | yes |
| one account, closed | yes — a new account, the closed one not reused |
| one account, active | no — coverage changes go on the existing account |
| one account, in collections | no |
| two closed accounts, nothing else | yes |

### Basis Q&A

**Q. A parent pays the bills of two children. Is one account opened for the household?** No. Each child keeps one account in the child's own name; the parent paying as guarantor does not merge them.

**Q. A patient moves from a commercial plan to self-pay. Is a Self-Pay Account opened beside the existing one?** No. The move is recorded on the existing Patient Financial Account by a coverage update.
